description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopQuery" name="Shop query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShopOffers" name="Shop offers"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsBatch" name="Parts batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ComplaintEmail" name="Complaint email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all shops" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_ShopOffers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts orders" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatches" name="Subsequent parts batches" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Event_SubsequentBatchStart" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts from fastest shop" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder parts from cheapest shop" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_ComplaintEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Start contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all shops for quantities, prices, and delivery times" messageRef="Message_ShopQuery"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive shop offers" messageRef="Message_ShopOffers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectParts" name="Select the cheapest parts, using several shops if one shop has insufficient parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrders" name="Order parts from the shops" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive the first parts batch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndStock" name="Build and manage stock">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BuildAndStock" name="Start building after first parts arrive"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build the contract project"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock for each part"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroStock" name="Is stock zero?" default="Flow_Zero_No"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops" messageRef="Message_ComplaintEmail"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroMerge" name="Continue stock checks"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowThree" name="Is stock below 3?" default="Flow_Three_No"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts from the fastest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThreeMerge" name="Continue stock checks"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowFive" name="Is stock below 5?" default="Flow_Five_No"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder parts from the cheapest shop" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FiveMerge" name="Finish stock check"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BuildAndStock" name="Stock check complete"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_LaterBatches" name="Handle subsequent parts batches (random order; typically +/- 2 days)" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_SubsequentBatchStart" name="Subsequent parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsBatch"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock for the received batch"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterBatch" name="Batch stock updated"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_1" sourceRef="Event_SubsequentBatchStart" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="End_LaterBatch"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildStock_1" sourceRef="Start_BuildAndStock" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildStock_2" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildStock_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock == 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Merge" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroMerge_Three" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroMerge" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Three_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Three_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_ThreeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fast_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_ThreeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThreeMerge_Five" sourceRef="Gateway_ThreeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_BelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Five_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Five_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_FiveMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheap_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_FiveMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FiveMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_FiveMerge" targetRef="End_BuildAndStock"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Contract work complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SelectParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndStock" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
